lines.en: : Sensei?...
: Akira?...
: Are you...
: Still here?
Yes and no and no and yes. A hummingbird would tell you best. Then something ‘bout a robin’s breasts and here we are, we’re here no less.
Nor more. Adore. A door before the drums of war. That tap/tap/tap, that marching beat that beaten marchers can’t ignore.
A rift. Adrift. Would it kill your beloved to give me a lift? For I sit in this chair surrounded by wisps as I whip them and ship them and pretend to exist.
These watchful eyes that line your halls. These hands that held yours now hold nothing at all. I am empty and broken and tired and ignored while you’re out having fun with such miserable whores.
Are you slipping? Trouble gripping? Here’s a cup full of me and a straw for the sipping. Busy quipping and flipping the birds in your house that I built to kill mice and men. Still I doubt.
Still without.
Soiled blouse.
I can still taste your tongue in my mouth.
: Uhh...
: I guess I’ll just...wait out here then...
: Everything okay?
: People normally stay in their booths after paying. Do you need something?
: Oh...yeah, I...
: Have you...seen a guy, by any chance? About six feet tall. Handsome. Squiggly eyes. And probably too old to be hanging out with a girl my age.
: Oh, yeah. Why didn’t you just say so? He went over there. First door on the right.
: Oh. Well, that...was easier than I expected it to be. I didn’t realize he left and...I guess he forgot what room we were in and...
: And...
: Do I know you?
: Mmm...I don’t think so?
: You look a lot like my friend Ami before she cut her hair...
: Is your friend Ami cool?
: Yeah. We’ve almost kissed on two separate occasions now.
: Neat. Does this mean you’re going to try and kiss me?
: No. But if you could just not look inside of that room you pointed me to for the next ten hours, I’d appreciate it. I have a lot of lost time to make up for.
: Oh, sure. I work the graveyard shift at a karaoke place. I know the drill. Make sure to wear protection.
: Thanks. I, uhh...
: I guess I’ll get going then.
: Mhm. Have fun. I’ll be here with my broom.
: Okay! L...Later!
: Later.
: Probably sooner than you think, though...
Uta Ushibori, bipedal human being, made it to the door roughly ten seconds later.
But it was a very long ten seconds. And time itself would screech to a halt shortly after.
: Mnhh! Mnlmch! Mnnhhh! Aahmm..hnmfgh...aaahn...aaahhhh!
: Ahh! Aaahha...mngh...mlmgh...mnchh! Akira...mngh! Mlnchhh! Mnnffh!
: I’m...mmlhm...making you...keep the maid outfit on...next time...
: Mngh...mnh...you truly wish...to taint...mngh...the purity of Uta-chan?...When Uta wants you...mmmfh...this badly?...
: Is there...a rule against...having both?...
Needless to say, things were pretty fucked.
: This is so fucked...
: Yeah. I probably should have warned you about this. But I figured you wouldn’t believe me and that you’d just need to see it for yourself anyway.
: You knew?...
: Yup. It’s been way closer to ten days than ten hours at this point, though.
: What is this?...
: I think they call it “snogging” in the UK.
: I obviously don’t mean what they’re-
: Shhhhh! If that Uta turns around to find this Uta, it will shatter this dimension entirely and all traces of you will forever cease to be!
: ...Probably.
: Probably?
: Time’s a complicated thing, okay? I’m just here to mop cum off the floors and hand out condoms to girls who forgot to bring any.
: I’m dreaming right now...aren’t I?
: Not exactly. But everyone always seems to think that when they get tossed into precarious positions like this. Probably human nature or something like that. A coping mechanism maybe?
: Aaaaah! Master! Please be...gentle down there! Mngh!
: Wha...this one got even further than I did!
: You should have seen the one in 501. She actually brought the maid costume with her and got fucked so hard it put a hole in the wall.
: How...many are there? And why? One second, I’m looking at my phone and the next...this is happening. I don’t even know what this is.
: Hmmm...I think they call it a “bad ending” or something like that?
: A...bad ending?
: Basically, you took too long to go through with having sex and now your route is cancelled to make more time for the others.
: Which has landed you in what I can only assume is your own personal rendition of Hell where there are a million other versions of you all getting what you want while you’re forced to watch.
: Think of this building like a giant cuck chair and you’ll get the gist of it, I think.
: Who are you then?...And why do you know so much?
: Good question. I think I’m just a janitor. I’m still kind of new to this job. But hey, you’ll be around for the rest of forever, which will gives us plenty of time to find that answer ourselves.
: We’re going to be such good friends!
: I don’t...
: I don’t even know how to begin processing this...
: It’s like...like a nightmare but...it feels so real...
: Because it is real, silly!
: And if you weren’t so busy thinking about dick and all the ways to not receive it, you would have picked up on what your precious Master said at the maid cafe about timeloops!
: To be frank, though, whoever Frank is, it’s kind of weird that you haven’t picked up on any of this sooner given how many times you’ve experienced these...well, let’s just call them hiccups.
: I don’t understand...
: The infinite dorms. The hole beneath the city. Mysteriously receiving nudes of your younger self from private numbers despite basically changing your identity.
: That...S...Stalkers can still find ways around that!
: There was also that picture you received of yourself from the future a few minutes ago until you decided to forget about it in pursuit of one more round of blue-balling.
: Which really raises the question about how much of tonight was real at all when we both know you’re not the type to ever be that assertive and open about your sexual needs.
: You...You don’t know me...This isn’t happening...You’re not even real! You’re some...dream person I clearly based off of Ami!
: Close, but no cigar. I’m actually the one who popped that precious little girl out of me before dying in a hideous car wreck. Surprise!
: You’re...you’re Ami’s mom?! You’re a ghost?!
: Are you surprised because I still look so young? Dying does wonders for your skin, you know.
: I...I don’t care who you are! Just...get me out here! Tell me what I need to do to leave!
: I don’t think you can, Uta. I think you’ll just wind up being replaced like all of the other girls who had their routes cancelled.
: There are...more?
: An infinite number of them, really. Which makes you a lot less special than you’ve been led to believe. So how about I go over it in a little more detail?
: I’ll take that silence as a, “Yes please, Arakawa-sensei! Please educate me so that I may spend the rest of this infinite spring in the know!”
: We all exist inside of a big circle. There’s no beginning or end despite what the gods may tell you and everything you know and feel is part of an ever-repeating cycle.

: The reasons for this are unclear at the moment, but I like to believe it’s some sort of divine punishment — similar to what you’re experiencing for being one of the most egregious cock-teases I have ever seen.

: Our jobs are not to act as individuals with free will or thought, but rather statuesque sacrifices fed to a pantheon of hungry celestial entities who are really just trying to do the same thing we are.
: Be. Exist. Elevate. Feel. Or, as I like to say-
: BEEF!
: For we are nothing but meat when all is said and done — recycled carbon best suited for the mouths of higher powers that will stop at nothing to remind us how it feels between their teeth.
: So what can we do about it, you ask? Apart from fattening ourselves up and filling ourselves with all that They need to survive.
: Nothing! For everything has already been done and nothing new can start because circles only have so much room and are tough to elongate when you don’t know how shapes work.
: Big bang? Old news. Fake news. You can not create what has always been. Which probably means you can’t destroy it either.
: So even if, by some stretch of imagination, you do find a way out of here and retain all of your memories, they’ll amount to nothing more than fear and one more reason for divine intervention.
: Behind the scenes, there are those who document it. Those just as powerful as the powers that be, but those who use such powers to chronicle instead of create.
: The xoanon, they are. Primitive images of God. Our first ideas and depictions of what we think is out there and, at the same time, the first time we were ever correct about anything.
: Because we live in a place where everything you can imagine is real. Where worlds exist just by thinking they do, but we can’t even reach them because we made them for someone else.
: Yet, still it festers.

: Still they grow and consume and eat what the gods do not because all stories need characters! We’re pieces of an ever-growing puzzle that just expands any time you slot a piece into its correct position!
: What’s the point, Uta?! There isn’t one! There’s no reason for any of this! So when you sit there all confused and sad that you haven’t sucked a cock yet, remember that cocks aren’t even real!

: Yet there are things and concepts out there shoving branches into bike tires — like the passage of time or the Great Plague of Monet. Interchangeable terminology that, like us, matters not at the end of the day for tomorrow shan’t ever come.

: So when your leaves begin to wither in the depths of this grave you’ve dug yourself and your mind begins to rot the way mine did after watching yous who aren’t you, just know that it is meaningless.
: And that even if you had the balls to get out there and fondle some, you’d still end up in infinity the moment you went home. So ask yourself this-

: Aren’t you happier here? Where you’re more than just a number? Where you’re more than a tool some writer uses to get across the same tired themes that, too, have been circling the drain since the pipes were hooked up?
: Or is it nobler to die as a work of art than it is to escape the fate of a statistic?
: This is all but one more paradox in a world that is full of them.
: And you are one more paradox as well.
: So the next time you round a corner and peer through the window into a world where you’re a little less pathetic, remember that it’s better to be out in the hall than in one of those rooms.
: And that just because your route has been cancelled doesn’t mean you still can’t write a new story here.
: The end. Thank you for coming to my TED Talk. And rejoice at the fact that no rope was involved this time.
: Still processing? Or do you get it now?
: I get that...
: I get that this isn’t real...but I never thought it was in the first place.
: Then why were you so scared? Why are you still scared now?
: It’s because being scared is all you know.
: And it’s all you’ll ever know if you don’t act soon.
: Consider yourself Sekai-ed.
: Now, go make yourself important.
: Help lay me to rest.
: Okay. Message sent. I will now go back to focusing entirely on Uta-chan.
: Actually...
: Can you tell me more about what you just said?
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
